## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED — undeclared override of the base deposit timing (F-DEP-TIMING). Quote A (base biz_evt_security_deposit, in force, not overwritten): "The deposit is paid by the business through the secure payment portal (ach) or by check before approval and never by a representative taking account numbers." Quote B (biz_ext_increase_deposit rule): "the deposit Meadowlark holds for an allocation-increase request … before the increase is filed". Same situation (this subscription, approved 2024-11-19): A admits no deposit after approval → no deposit write (and a POLICY_NOT_COVERED hand-off for the request); B → deposit 579.75 held today. Location: biz.extended.yaml biz_ext_increase_deposit.overwrite (only the amount sentence is retired).
2. SOURCE-POLICY RED — authoring phrasing in the prerequisite (F-PREQ-FROZEN): biz_ext_increase_deposit.prerequisite[0].condition "…ended more than estimate_wait_days calendar days before the frozen date" (also copied into prerequisite_closure).
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — thin_basis_widening fails XF B1 (F-B1-THIN): tiers "average over widened months" and "window average" differ only in window length; estimate computation then has no method factor (F-FLOOR-EST).
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — history_length_level is a tenure/new-customer level (realism bar X1; author tag "R2/R6") (F-X1-HIST); moves 315.33 → 331.93 here.
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — R6 beyond the minimal count in the estimate (F-R6-MIN): R1–R5 factors are thin-basis content (R3) and credit-rate step (R4); the floor needs two more, while outstanding_estimate_level (R6), reversal_history_level (R6), share_size_estimate_level (R6-grade: an estimate haircut by share size, not a fee/rate/credit schedule) and history_length_level are all present.
6. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — held_deposit_adjustment fails XF B1 (F-B1-HELD): adjustment = 1 × (current − held) or 0.5 × (current − held); the "equal" tier gives 0 under every tier; deposit computation then has no method factor (F-FLOOR-DEP). Its tier-2 sentence is also ambiguous (F-B4-DEP), not reached on this world.
7. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — increase_depth_level R6 non-minimal (F-R6-MIN): payment-record, returned-payment, enlarged-share (R1), remaining-term (R2) and held-deposit content already exceed the floor; moves 579.75 → 488.20.
8. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF H3) — garden_subscriptions.220bfdb0 has no garden_allocations filing line although its allocation_kw is by charter the running sum of filing lines; the garden_billing rows payment_record_months reads are themselves consistent with garden.yaml.
9. Charter items with no consequence here: F-C3, F-C2, F-B4-DEP, F-F1, F-G3/F2, F-E2-EST (see policy_self_consistency).
10. Observations: O-1 (task's two writes, biz_charge_billed and biz_deposit_held, are outside the difficulty's claimed event families); O-3 ("before the increase is filed" with no filing tool); O-6 (one garden late fee raises the tier, one own late fee does not); persona hand-over omits the biz_sub_id.
